title: The Immortal Life of Henrietta Lacks
author: Rebecca Skloot
summary: Rebecca Skloot traces how cells taken from a poor Black woman dying of cancer in 1951 became the HeLa line used across medicine. She also tells the story of Henrietta's family, who learned of it decades later.
readIf: you like science writing that treats ethics and human stories as seriously as the research.
skipIf: you want a technical account of cell biology.
